svg.title: openmeet-engine: per-meeting answer-integrity state, checks and gaze commands (integrity.rs)

g.text: openmeet-engine: per-meeting answer-integrity state, checks and gaze commands (integrity.rs)
confirms the capture about 2 s after a start
active: interviewer mode and (forced or settings.integrity.enabled).
version: bumped on every utterance start and end; a timer fires
only for the latest version, after turn_end_silence_ms of silence.
flags: latest revision of each answer, in answer order.
Built under the state lock, run after release.
previous: the running check of the same answer, cancelled
when a newer revision starts (its flag is never stored).
